data.title: 平冢静 · 沿海公路观景台皮衣靠车的夜色远眺
data.description: 千叶沿海高地公路观景台，平冢静身穿修身黑色机车皮衣与紧身牛仔裤，斜倚在深红色阿斯顿马丁跑车车门旁，海风吹拂黑发，远眺万家灯火。
data.location: 千叶沿海公路深夜观景高台
data.action: 双手插在皮衣口袋倚在爱车前翼子板旁，微仰头感受微凉海风，眼神洒脱深远
data.lighting: 跑车车灯在柏油路面切出的两道白光，远方海湾城市夜景如繁星铺展
data.camera: 广角中全景，将红色超跑、修长身段与海湾夜色完美融为一体
data.promptProse: Shizuka Hiratsuka stands against the fender of her crimson sports car at a deserted cliffside overlook along the Chiba coastal highway at midnight. Clad in a tailored black leather moto jacket over dark denim jeans that accentuate her tall, athletic build, she gazes across the twinkling panoramic carpet of city lights across the bay. The cool ocean wind tousles her black hair as she enjoys the quiet night air.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against her crimson sports car on the windy coastal overlook, Shizuka looks out over the midnight bay with cool poise.
